methodology: We measure width, depth, and height on every appliance with a steel rule — not manufacturer rounding.
Each pick is evaluated for cord length, vent clearance, and cabinet swing interference.
Pricing is re-checked weekly; stale affiliate links are removed within 7 days.
We disclose every affiliate relationship in plain English at the top of the relevant article.
Reader corrections are answered within 72 hours and folded into the article when valid.

about.headline: Why Counter Crew exists
about.body: Most appliance reviews ignore the counter. Counter Crew starts with the footprint: width, depth, height, and clearance for cabinets and outlets. We test small-kitchen staples — air fryers, drip and pod coffee, immersion blenders, two-slice toasters — and say plainly when something is too big for a standard rental galley.
